Compute medial-axis symmetry scores

Source: R/mat.R
compute_mat_properties.Rd

Compute medial-axis symmetry scores

Usage

compute_mat_properties(
  mat,
  properties = c("parallelism", "separation", "mirror"),
  window = 5L,
  power = 10,
  spec = mat$feature_spec,
  pixels_per_degree = NULL
)

Arguments

mat

An mlv_mat object.

properties

Requested branch score names.

window, power

Branch score parameters.

spec

Optional feature specification, exclusive of individual settings.

pixels_per_degree

Optional input calibration override.

Value

An mlv_mat with branch scores and score images; unmapped pixels are NA.

Details

Under `branch_rule="invariant"` (default) a branch score is NA where its estimator is undefined (see [score_branch()]). The scores of the two traversal directions are averaged over the defined ones; a score image pixel is the maximum of the defined scores at that pixel over all branches (and over both occurrences of a junction pixel closing a loop), NA if none is defined. For contour mapping see [map_mat_properties()]. Under `branch_rule="mlv2023"` undefined points carry the published zeros.
